title: Partner
description: One partner organization as authored in partners/<name>.json. scripts/build-partners.mjs assembles these files into v1/partners.json, the signed partner keyring. See docs/signing.md.

public_key.description: The partner's minisign public key, whole or as its single key line. Packages whose plugin.sums it signs install as verified.

expires.description: Last day hosts treat the key as a partner key through the keyring. Optional.

revoked.description: true removes the partner from the keyring and lists its key id under revoked, which ends partner trust for that key on every host, certificate or not.

reason.description: Why the key was revoked. Required when revoked is true, and only used then.

name.description: Partner id: the file name without .json, and the <name> in a partner certificate's trusted comment partner:<name>;expires:<YYYY-MM-DD>.

publicKeyText.description: A minisign public key in text form, with or without its untrusted comment line.

publicKeyLine.description: The base64 key line of a minisign public key.

keyId.description: A minisign key id as minisign prints it: bytes 2..10 of the decoded key line, little endian, 16 upper case hex digits.
